newsitem.title: UK: UK monetary policy committee meets at 1400 GMT Wed.
newsitem.headline: UK monetary policy committee meets at 1400 GMT Wed.

text.p: The Bank of England's Monetary Policy Committee will begin its two-day meeting at 1400 GMT on Wednesday and will announce its decision on interest rates at 1100 GMT on Thursday, a central bank official said.
The committee held its pre-meeting briefing with officials on July 4. The pre-meeting briefing will normally be held the week before the meeting, the official said.
